title: Bulk Email Verifier
description: Check a list of email addresses. Each address is saved once, with a status of valid, invalid, risky, disposable, or unknown. Unknown results are not charged.

emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: Addresses to verify, one per line. To load them from storage instead, add a line such as dataset:DATASET_ID#email or kv:STORE_ID/RECORD_KEY#email. The part after # is the field name and defaults to email. The sample lines use the reserved .invalid domain so a run finishes without contacting a real mail server.

smtpTimeoutMs.title: SMTP timeout
smtpTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for each SMTP connection, in milliseconds. The same limit applies to the domain lookup. The random-address probe uses the time left on that same connection.

maxConcurrentPerDomain.title: Max checks per mail domain
maxConcurrentPerDomain.description: How many checks may run at the same time against one mail domain. Other domains still run in parallel. The maximum is 3, so a large batch cannot open a pile of connections to one server.

checkCatchAll.title: Detect catch-all domains
checkCatchAll.description: After a mail server accepts an address, check one random address at the same domain on that same connection. If the server accepts that too, the result is risky instead of valid.

checkRoleAccounts.title: Flag role accounts
checkRoleAccounts.description: Mark shared mailboxes such as info@, admin@, and support@ with isRoleAccount. This is a flag on the result, not a separate status.
